summary: Re-verified Tonbridge Warehouse permission-gate fix from iteration_191. The updated has_permission() in services/auth.py now correctly honours extra_pages / denied_pages overrides. Full pytest suite for /app/backend/tests/test_warehouse.py now passes 18/18 (added one new regression test for denied_pages precedence). All three regression cases confirmed: (1) super_admin still 200, (2) staff with no override still 403, (3) staff with extra_pages=['warehouse_manage'] AND denied_pages=['warehouse_manage'] correctly gets 403 (denials win).
critical_code_review_comments: services/auth.py has_permission() fix is correct and well-documented. Resolution order is unambiguous (super_admin > denied_pages > extra_pages > legacy permissions).

Note: role-default pages are still NOT consulted by has_permission() — the docstring correctly flags this. If any future action-level key (e.g. 'warehouse_manage') ever gets baked into a role default page list, callers of has_permission() would still 403 unless the user is granted via extra_pages or legacy permissions. Consider a follow-up to also read the effective role_pages for parity with /permissions/me, or add a clear comment in code where role defaults are defined.
test_credentials: admin@test.com / admin123 (super_admin). Test staff users are created & deleted per-run with prefix TEST_warehouse_staff_*.
seed_data_creation: Test staff user is created and deleted by the pytest fixture (best-effort cleanup). Warehouse stock adjustments persist across runs — 'Floor Tile Grey 600x600' (SKU FT-001) toggled between 50 and 85.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The permission-gate bug from iteration_191 is fully fixed. test_warehouse.py has 18 test cases including test_denied_pages_wins_over_extra_pages regression. All 4 review-request scenarios verified: super_admin=200, staff-without-override=403, staff-with-extra_pages=200, extra+denied=403. Frontend was not retested per explicit instruction.
rca of the issue: N/A — fix has been verified. Iteration_191 RCA is preserved in that report.
